evidence.claim: Analyst request: several cards this month show losses with no shared device, requesting review of transaction 3660127 on card C06220-K1 for shared features.

Card C06220-K1 generated 3 online product code C transactions (3660125, 3660126, 3660127) between 2017-01-17 and 2017-01-19 totaling $2,166.71 using New SM-J700T1 mobile profiles behind IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS.
Prior to transaction 3660127, card C06220-K1 had only 2 prior product code C purchases in 366 prior transactions, indicating an atypical product usage pattern.
The episode transaction amounts ($637.13, $758.80, $770.78) significantly exceed the cardholder's prior median transaction amount of $107.92.
Card C06220-K1 has 5 prior closed cases of confirmed fraud (CC-0626, CC-2539, CC-2807, CC-4224, CC-5379) and 1 prior cleared case (CC-0815).
The case-memory calibrated probability (cms_p) for transaction 3660127 was 0.011531 and the real-time risk score was 0.07.

case.summary: This case is evaluated as fraud with 0.92 probability under an undocumented pattern involving a coordinated anonymous-proxy mobile wave on product C purchases across cards. The episode comprises transactions 3660125, 3660126, and 3660127 for a total exposure of $2,166.71. Decisive facts include 3 New mobile profiles behind IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS and amounts far above the card's prior median ($107.92). Recommended actions include blocking card C06220-K1 (L1 approval) and filing a SAR (L2 approval).

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is filed regarding an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern under internal case id AC-HHF-002, opened 2017-01-19. The investigation involves customer C06220 and credit card C06220-K1, which participated in a coordinated anonymous-proxy mobile wave across cards. On 2017-01-17 at 19:58, transaction 3660125 for $637.13 was executed online in region 330.0 under product code C using device profile SM-J700T1 | iOS 11.1.2 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2048x1536 behind an anonymous proxy. On 2017-01-18 at 19:48, transaction 3660126 for $758.80 was executed online in region 384.0 under product code C using device profile SM-J700T1 | iOS 11.1.1 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2048x1536 behind an anonymous proxy. On 2017-01-19 at 18:18, transaction 3660127 for $770.78 was executed online in region 126.0 under product code C using device profile SM-J700T1 | NULL | NULL | NULL behind an anonymous proxy. This rapid online activity is highly unusual compared to the card's baseline prior to opening of 366 transactions with a median amount of $107.92 and only 2 prior product code C purchases. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card (6 earlier closed case(s), none reported); closed cases CC-3436, CC-3419 on the same device profile or connected cards were confirmed fraud with reports filed. OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. Case creation, monitoring of connected cards, and escalation to an analyst were completed automatically, while a block of card C06220-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this report filing is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval, covering a total suspicious exposure of $2,166.71.
